Imperial [Imperial Oil] (2025). Cold Lake Operations, Directive 054 Annual Submission 2024 (Commercial Scheme Approval 8558). Annual in situ performance presentation to the Alberta Energy Regulator, dated 30 June 2025; reporting period 1 January to 31 December 2024. File 2025-imperial-coldlake-8558.pdf.

Reporting year 2024 (deck dated June 30, 2025). Loaded: district and per-plant (Maskwa, Mahihkan, Leming, Mahkeses, Nabiye) 2024 bitumen production as annual-output (m3/d x 366, leap year) and approval bitumen inlet limits as capacity (p.47-48); district steam injection per m3 bitumen as a flow (p.13, 102.4/23.9); descriptions of LASER and SA-SAGD. Other-values: HP steam generation actual and design per plant, generated-steam SOR per plant, approval gas/water inlet and CO2 emission limits, 2023 production, cumulative OSR, well count, cogeneration years, LASER/SA-SAGD diluent ratios and recoveries, NCG trial. Not printed in this deck (the revised Directive 054 format drops them): fuel gas, purchased/produced gas, electricity import/export, cogeneration MW and output, GHG totals or intensity, produced/make-up/disposal water volumes, water-treatment type, steam generator counts or efficiency, solvent volumes injected. So no specific-energy-consumption, emissions or water-treatment rows. Skipped: geoscience, pad recovery tables, sulphur, abandonment, compliance. Locator: PDF page = printed slide number. Traps: (1) p.13 production 23.9 10^3 m3/d versus p.48 23,533 m3/d for the same year (p.13 includes CSP and SA-SAGD pilots); (2) p.48 steam is HP steam generated, p.13 is injected and CWE is not stated; (3) the 40,000 m3/d capacity is an approval inlet limit, not nameplate; (4) cumulative OSR 0.27 is printed for both years; (5) p.42 SA-SAGD iSOR chart not read (image; reprinted from Imperial 2014 IETP report).
